scope: Curated shortlist for website reading and audio generation; not an exhaustive registry or a quality benchmark. Recommended uses are editorial judgments. Model versions, language lists and licenses must be checked before deployment.

offline.name: System speech (Windows SAPI / macOS / Android)
offline.use: Fast setup, accessibility and fallback; quality depends on installed voices
offline.status: Windows SAPI and macOS say adapters implemented; macOS requires target-device verification

offline.name: Web Speech API local voices
offline.use: Zero-model-download website read-aloud; cannot export audio through the standard API
offline.status: Browser module implemented; localService filter plus disconnected-device verification required

offline.name: sherpa-onnx
offline.use: Cross-platform offline runtime for VITS, Matcha, Kokoro and other model families
offline.status: Python adapter implemented for VITS/Matcha/Kokoro; user supplies models

offline.name: Kokoro / kokoro-js
offline.use: Compact neural speech; browser WASM/WebGPU or local runtime; language support differs by checkpoint and frontend
offline.status: Via sherpa with matching model config; native kokoro-js integration is a candidate

offline.name: Piper (OHF-Voice)
offline.use: CPU and edge-device speech with downloadable voices
offline.status: Candidate; current engine is GPL; voice licenses are separate; old rhasspy repository is not the current upstream

offline.name: Qwen3-TTS
offline.use: Local multilingual speech with fixed/custom voices and instruction control, depending on model
offline.status: Candidate; evaluate GPU requirements and exact model variant

offline.name: CosyVoice
offline.use: Chinese and multilingual local synthesis, including streaming and reference-voice workflows
offline.status: Candidate; capabilities differ by version and serving implementation

offline.name: MeloTTS
offline.use: Conventional multilingual local speech; a useful CPU-oriented baseline

offline.name: GPT-SoVITS
offline.use: Few-shot speaker customization, especially Chinese and East Asian languages
offline.status: Candidate; larger training and reference-audio workflow

offline.name: Chatterbox
offline.status: Candidate; select exact model and language pack

offline.name: F5-TTS
offline.status: Conditional candidate; official pretrained models carry noncommercial terms; do not treat code license as model license

offline.name: Fish Speech
offline.use: Expressive multilingual speech and locally hosted voice workflows
offline.status: Conditional candidate; inspect current Fish Audio Research License and model terms

offline.name: OpenVoice
offline.use: Voice tone conversion and cloning combined with a base TTS engine
offline.status: Specialist candidate; not a standalone replacement for every TTS pipeline

offline.name: VibeVoice
offline.status: Specialist candidate; verify availability, model license and active TTS serving path separately from ASR

offline.name: eSpeak NG
offline.use: Very lightweight deterministic fallback and phonemization; robotic speech quality

online.name: Azure AI Speech
online.use: General multilingual websites, SSML and enterprise integration
online.status: REST WAV/MP3 adapter and voice listing implemented

online.name: ElevenLabs
online.use: Expressive narration, voice selection and provider-supported timing metadata
online.status: MP3 adapter and first page of voice listing implemented; timestamps/streaming are not implemented

online.name: OpenAI Speech API
online.use: Instruction-guided speech and integration with existing OpenAI applications
online.status: Use configurable speech-api adapter with an available model; no model version is hardcoded

online.name: Google Cloud Text-to-Speech
online.use: Google Cloud applications, multilingual speech and voice families including Chirp
online.status: Candidate; API/SSML/streaming support differs by voice family

online.name: Gemini TTS
online.use: Prompt-controlled speech and multi-speaker audio production
online.status: Candidate; distinct from Google Cloud Text-to-Speech and from Live conversational audio

online.name: Amazon Polly
online.status: Candidate; voice, engine and region compatibility must match

online.name: Alibaba Cloud Model Studio Qwen TTS / CosyVoice
online.use: Chinese websites and Alibaba Cloud integration
online.status: dashscope adapter implements Qwen-TTS non-realtime Beijing/Singapore WAV output; hosted CosyVoice is still a candidate

online.name: Volcengine Doubao Speech
online.use: Chinese voice applications, streaming and asynchronous long-form audio
online.status: Candidate; API/resource versions have different authentication and capabilities

online.name: MiniMax Speech
online.use: Multilingual expressive speech and streaming voice products

online.name: Tencent Cloud TTS
online.use: Chinese/English mixed speech and Tencent Cloud integration

online.name: iFlytek TTS
online.use: Chinese voice services and existing iFlytek ecosystems
online.status: Candidate; use current streaming API rather than retired ordinary WebAPI

online.name: Cartesia Sonic
online.status: Candidate; validate target-region latency and language quality

online.name: Resemble AI
online.use: Managed speech and custom-voice workflows with Chatterbox ecosystem
online.status: Candidate; hosted service terms differ from local models

online.name: Edge TTS
online.use: Preferred online reading and cached MP3 generation across macOS/Linux/Windows
online.status: Implemented with explicit proxy and timeout; network availability is not guaranteed

online.name: Youdao dictionary voice
online.use: English word and short-phrase pronunciation and audio saving
online.status: Implemented with HTTPS, encoded query and US/UK accents; not arbitrary-text TTS; no paid API credentials
